plain.对该失败模式关联的任务样本进行共同因子分析；将根因定位到输入合同、路由、实施步骤: Analyze common factors across task samples associated with this failure pattern. Locate the root cause within one responsibility boundary: input contract, routing, implementation step, validation, or review. Prefer preflight validation, negative tests, or precise triggers without increasing the default model tier or reviewer count.
plain.对比推荐档位与实际升级任务的复杂度、风险、上下文长度和修复结果；修订复杂度特征或: Compare complexity, risk, context length, and repair outcomes between recommended tiers and tasks that actually escalated. Revise complexity features or escalation thresholds, then replay historical samples to verify cost savings without reducing the blocking-finding hit rate.
plain.提取偏差任务的正样本和容易误触发的负样本；收紧或补充 Skill 触发词、排除条: Extract positive samples from misrouted tasks and negative samples likely to trigger falsely. Tighten or extend Skill triggers, exclusions, and primary/supporting Skill composition rules. Never hide routing problems by loading more Skills by default.
plain.审查实施前任务信封、Review Packet、验收标准和依赖识别是否完整；将重: Review whether the pre-implementation Task Envelope, Review Packet, acceptance criteria, and dependency identification are complete. Move recurring rework causes into Preflight or targeted validation. Preserve the repair-round ceiling and never allow unbounded self-repair.
plain.先将该 Reviewer 从默认组合降为按需触发并进入观察期；保留高风险场景回退: First remove this reviewer from the default combination, make it on-demand, and begin an observation period while retaining a fallback for high-risk scenarios. A separate deprecation implementation task may be created only after quality does not decline during observation and a human approves it.
plain.检查 Reviewer 职责是否与其他 Reviewer 重叠、输入 Packe: Check whether reviewer responsibilities overlap, the input Packet lacks required evidence, or task samples do not match. Replay a controlled comparison between default and on-demand groups, then evaluate discovery rate, false-positive rate, and cost before deciding on an adjustment.
plain.按失败类别、Skill、项目阶段、模型档位和 Reviewer 组合分层复盘；补: Stratify review by failure category, Skill, project phase, model tier, and reviewer combination. Add structured fields that distinguish root causes. Until one high-confidence root cause exists, create an investigation task only and do not change global rules.
plain.收集更多独立任务证据，明确价值、复杂度、风险、回滚和验证边界后再决定是否修改。: Collect evidence from more independent tasks and define value, complexity, risk, rollback, and validation boundaries before deciding whether to change anything.
plain.降低不必要的模型升级和 Token/credits 消耗，同时保持任务质量与 B: Reduce unnecessary model escalation and token or credit consumption while preserving task quality and blocking-finding coverage.
plain.减少低收益 Reviewer 调用和重复上下文加载，并保留高风险任务的兜底覆盖。: Reduce low-yield reviewer calls and duplicate context loading while retaining fallback coverage for high-risk tasks.
plain.降低 Skill 误触发、漏触发和无关 Reference 加载，提高任务范围识: Reduce false or missed Skill triggers and unrelated Reference loading, improving task-scope recognition.
plain.将问题发现前移，减少集中修复轮次、上下文漂移和重复验证。: Move problem discovery earlier and reduce consolidated repair rounds, context drift, and duplicate validation.
plain.降低同类故障复发率和人工返工成本，使失败能够在更早阶段被阻断。: Reduce recurrence and manual rework for the same failure category so failures can be blocked earlier.
plain.提高结果稳定性和可解释性，为后续受控优化提供可比较基线。: Improve outcome stability and explainability, providing a comparable baseline for later controlled optimization.
plain.实施前记录目标文件、规则、模型配置或 Reviewer Profile 的完整哈: Before implementation, record complete hashes and the Git baseline for target files, rules, model configuration, or reviewer profiles
plain.所有变更以独立任务和最小提交实施，不覆盖历史提案、Evidence 和观察快照: Implement every change through a separate task and minimum commit without overwriting historical proposals, Evidence, or observation snapshots
plain.验证失败、质量下降或成本异常时恢复原配置并重新执行原回归基线: Restore the original configuration and rerun the original regression baseline if validation fails, quality declines, or cost becomes abnormal
plain.回滚后记录失败原因和实际结果，不自动再次应用同一提案: After rollback, record the failure cause and actual outcome and do not reapply the same proposal automatically
plain.使用提案 Evidence 中的历史任务构造回放集，并补充至少一个负向对照样本: Build a replay set from historical tasks in the proposal Evidence and add at least one negative control sample
plain.比较修改前后的成功率、Blocking Finding、修复轮次、模型升级率和: Compare success rate, blocking findings, repair rounds, model-escalation rate, and reviewer cost before and after the change
plain.执行现有 Skill 路由回归、运行时合同测试、安装/恢复测试和最终读回校验: Run existing Skill-routing regressions, runtime-contract tests, installation and recovery tests, and final readback validation
